pessoagraph.what: An interactive knowledge graph mapping heteronymic practice across five thousand years — the Pessoa lineage and beyond, as federated linked data.
pessoagraph.why_here: The Armature crosses the whole map as mesh without becoming a room polygon. Heteronymy is the archive’s own load-bearing structure: twelve voices, an aperture, adjacent figures, each with institutions and venues. pessoagraph.org is that structure rendered for a readership outside the archive, and placed in a lineage rather than asserted as singular.
pessoagraph.theory: The Meta-Heteronym argues heteronymy as institutional technology rather than literary device — which is what the Armature is: not a theme running through the rooms but the frame they hang on.
